business_summary.text: Rajratan Global Wire Limited is a leading bead wire manufacturer with a capacity of 72,000 TPA in India and 60,000 TPA in Thailand, supplying to tyre majors across PV, CV, two-wheeler and off-the-road segments.

call_points.text: Thailand operations are adding 50,000 TPA capacity within one year with a capex of ₹125 Cr.
Thailand operations adding 50,000 TPA capacity within one year to reach 1,10,000 TPA total capacity.
Export volumes from India grew by 38-40% YoY in Q2FY27 supported by multinational customers in Europe and Americas.
Focus on market share growth and volume-led strategy to improve efficiencies
Disciplined capital allocation to generate sustainable growth
Chennai plant capacity is being expanded to 60,000 tons by Q2 FY27 with an additional capex of INR 25 crores.
EBITDA margin is expected to return to normal levels of 13% to 13.5% in the current quarter as raw material price hikes are passed on.

penalties.details: The Income Tax Department has passed an order dated 9 September 2026 under Section 270A of the Income-tax Act, 1961, for Assessment Year 2023–24, imposing a penalty of Rs. 65,250 on the Company in connection with the assessment of income for the said assessment year.
penalties.impact: The financial impact is limited to the penalty of Rs. 65,250. No impact on the Company's operational activities has been indicated.The Company has preferred an appeal against the said order before the Appellate Tribunal

guidance.statement: Target to grow business in volume by around 17% to 18% in the current year with total sales around 155,000 tons.

status_history.evidence: Q1FY27 sales volume reached 33,300 MT, representing 21.5% of the FY27 target of 155,000 tons
H1FY27 revenue ₹689.18 Cr, up 27.5% YoY; Thailand capacity at 95-100% utilisation with 50,000 TPA addition approved.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin is expected to return to normal levels of 13% to 13.5% in the current quarter as raw material price hikes are passed on.
Expanding Chennai facility capacity to 60,000 TPA by Q3 FY27
Adding 50,000 TPA capacity in Thailand within one year to reach 1,10,000 TPA
Targeting total consolidated sales volume of around 160,000 tons for the current financial year.

operating_notes.text: FY26 total sales volume reached over 133,000 tons.
Rajratan Thai Wire Co. Limited acquired land admeasuring 2.42124 acres along with a building constructed thereon admeasuring 3,053.5 square metres in Thailand.
Q1FY27 sales volume reached 33,300 MT (16% YoY growth)
Chennai facility began contributing positively to profits in Q1FY27
Management expects sustained focus on market share growth and higher utilisation across manufacturing facilities
Thailand plant (Rajratan Thai Wire) ran at 95-100% utilisation on 60,000 TPA capacity.
Rajratan Thai Wire reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹129.71 Cr and PAT of ₹5.47 Cr; Rajratan Wire USA revenue ₹35.60 Cr and PAT ₹1.93 Cr.
Rest of the World revenue was ₹167.63 Cr in Q2FY27 against ₹122.17 Cr a year earlier.
Q2FY27 sales volume reached 38,605 MT (23,344 MT India, 15,261 MT Thailand).
Chennai facility achieved turnaround from losses to profitability in Q2FY27.
Thailand facility uses 100% scrap-based raw material enabling production of green bead wire.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹314.29 Cr (+25.0% YoY), net profit ₹15.43 Cr (+1.5% YoY).
Rajratan Global Wire Limited shared the audio link for its 22nd April 2026 conference call on its website.
Rajratan Global Wire reported Q4 FY26 earnings transcript highlighting 133,000 tons annual volume growth and margin impact from raw material inflation.
2026-05-15: Rajratan's wholly owned subsidiary, Rajratan Thai Wire Co. Limited, acquired land and a building in Thailand adjacent to its existing facility.
2026-06-05: ICRA upgraded outlook for Rajratan Global Wire's ₹50 Cr bank facilities to stable
Q1FY27 results: Revenue ₹318 Cr (+29% YoY); PAT ₹22.96 Cr (+70% YoY)
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹370.83 Cr (+26.1% YoY), net profit ₹24.14 Cr (+17.5% YoY).
Rajratan Global Wire released its Q2FY27 investor presentation reporting 26% YoY revenue growth to ₹370.83 Cr and highlighting capacity expansions in Chennai and Thailand.
Shubham Jain digitally signed the audio recording of the Q2-FY27 conference call held on 2026-10-22, uploaded at https://rajratan.co.in/q2-fy27-post-results-conference-call.
2026-10-22: Rajratan Global Wire held its Q2FY27 earnings call, highlighting a planned ₹125 Cr brownfield expansion in Thailand to add 50,000 TPA capacity.
